summary: Full regression of iter62 improvements: regime-correlation (GET/POST/DELETE + runs persistence), /api/jobs/paused shape, autopilot run delete, job pause/resume with concurrent backtest on local worker, Backtester trail-mode UI, Regime-Lab correlation UI (Assets wording, matrix, saved runs with show/delete), autopilot history 'Regime suchen' button, and mobile paused-jobs badge/menu with 1-decimal percentage + variant count. All backend tests pass (7/7). All UI acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: regime_lab.py: GET /api/regime-correlation now returns {job,result,runs}; result includes id/requested/symbols/perfect/missing_reasons as required. DELETE run endpoint correctly 401s without admin and 200s with admin.
job_overview.py /api/jobs/paused: returns {jobs, count} with resume_path+cancel_path for each entry; worker frees slot on pause (verified by concurrent local backtest completing).
Backtester.js: bt-cfg-trailmode-<id> select exposes 4 options (Standard/tp1/profit_pct/crv); selecting profit_pct reveals bt-cfg-trailpct and bt-cfg-trailbe; crv reveals bt-cfg-trailcrv.
PausedJobsBadge: shows 'N pausiert' only when a job is paused; menu lists Fortsetzen+Abbrechen and the entry text includes progress with 1 decimal and 'Kombination x/y' variant counter.
Autopilot history: autopilot-run-analyze-<id> button present and triggers regime analysis (toast seen); DELETE /api/regime-lab/autopilot/runs/aptest_btc2 worked and aptest_btc1 preserved.
Minor obs: on wide-desktop Regime-Lab the correlation-missing block is only rendered when there are missing symbols (3/3 case had none) — expected.
seed_data_creation: Live correlation run executed via POST /api/regime-correlation (BTC/ETH/SOL 1h 30d) — added to persisted runs. aptest_btc2 autopilot run was deleted per instructions; aptest_btc1 kept.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression files: test_iter62_improvements.py (6 fast tests) and test_iter62_pause_e2e.py (slow, uses live local worker pod-test; requires no other optimizer running). Mobile paused badge test flow: POST /api/optimizer/run with execution=local -> wait ~15s -> POST /api/optimizer/pause/{id} -> reload UI -> data-testid='paused-jobs-toggle' appears with 'N pausiert', menu has paused-job-resume-{id}/paused-job-cancel-{id}. The Backtester trail config is only visible after clicking data-testid='bt-cfg-toggle-{strategy_id}'. For Regime-Lab correlation 'ansehen'/delete, use data-testid regime-correlation-run-show-{id}/regime-correlation-run-delete-{id}. Non-crypto correlation runs (GOLD etc.) are slow — avoid unless 300s+ timeout acceptable.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
